content.short: Cross-border neobank/local payout product using USDC-powered rails.
content.description: Munify is a stablecoin-powered cross-border neobank, backed by Y Combinator, built to help people and businesses in the Middle East and North Africa — starting with Egyptians abroad — move money globally with instant local payouts. It offers USD accounts, wallets, virtual cards, savings, and local cash-out across more than 80 countries, using USDC settlement over networks such as Ethereum and Base to bridge on-chain liquidity with local banking and payout partners. Through an integration with the Circle Payments Network, Munify enables USDC-powered payouts into markets like the Philippines, turning stablecoins into fast, low-cost cross-border rails. By wrapping this infrastructure in a familiar banking experience, Munify serves both consumers and businesses that need dependable global money movement in and out of emerging markets.
content.meta: Munify is a stablecoin-powered cross-border neobank with USDC payouts for MENA. Discover Munify and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
